source_files.role: The export declarations: exportFeatureMapToMzTab, exportIdentificationsToMzTab, extractModificationList, exportConsensusMapToMzTab, the nested IDMzTabStream and CMMzTabStream and the 22 protected statics (lines 540-872).
Read in full. Lines 306-350 (target/decoy remapping) and 698-3414 are the export surface ported into src/format/mztab_export.rs.

Lines 153-193 and 208-303: the two exporter sections, ported into tests/mztab_export.rs with every assertion.

The idXML reader cannot read MzTabExporter_6_input.idXML with the global modification registry (AASequence::parse_with_budget charges a whole-registry scan per named annotation against a fixed 50 M budget); the test reads through a registry of the global registry's Phospho, Oxidation and Carbamidomethyl records.
